posts.description: (One of my summaries of the 2026 one-day Pycon NL conference in Utrecht, NL). This year is the first community-organized Pycon NL: hurray! Most of us use open source as users . posts.title: Pycon NL: what's inside an asyncio event loop? - Taras Kozlov
posts.description: (One of my summaries of the 2026 one-day Pycon NL conference in Utrecht, NL). An asyncio event loop is defined by asyncio.AbstractEventLoop . That's a large API with more than 50 public methods, but only three are fundamental. At the lowest useful leve, the loop manages callbacks, i/o and timers.
